title: The Big Score Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "You think because you've mapped the land, you own the land. You own an idea, nothing more."
No one had seen this side of Angeline before, not even her.
Mora didn't want friends, but she didn't mind having someone to watch her back.
"Devour the hope of a world and it will bow before you." —Fomori inscription
